Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task by evaluating whether members had ever held C‑suite roles prior to joining Apple’s board, instead of assessing whether they held C‑suite positions at the time they joined. This incorrect frame led to the false conclusion that none fit the criterion, overlooking Wanda Austin, Ronald D. Sugar, and Susan L. Wagner.
